marketing_description: The Speed Queen® Professional Series DC5004BG sanitizing gas dryer offers a 7 cu‑ft galvanized‑steel drum and a 710 rpm rotation to efficiently dry commercial loads, powered by a 22 000 Btu/hr gas burner and 1/3 hp motor. Its design includes anti‑static construction, commercial cool‑down technology, extended tumble, lint‑filter guard, moisture sensor, and multiple steam functions such as boost, refresh and sanitize, while delivering 220 cfm exhaust airflow through a 4‑in. diameter outlet. The unit measures 43 in. H × 26‑7/8 in. W × 28 in. D, fits a 51‑½ in. depth with door open, and operates on 120 V.
